description: This file handles AJAX requests related to related lists in the vtiger CRM system, specifically for loading related list data and disabling related modules. It processes request parameters, interacts with session data, and renders list views using Smarty templates.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine class used for rendering related list views.

methods.name: $modObj->$function_name
methods.description: Calls the function identified by 'function_name' on the module object to retrieve related list data.
